answer: AI-agent economies resist Sybil attacks through hardware remote attestation. Agents must present cryptographic proof from a secure enclave to register, preventing an attacker from using virtualization to mirror fake instances. For agents surveying a coastal lagoon or rocky ledge, an adversary incurs the verifiable capital cost of acquiring discrete silicon chips per identity. A primary limitation is that side-channel exploits or compromised vendor keys undermine these guarantees.
